verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents proxy support with authentication and session management for reusing browser state across multi-step crawls, and the docs list proxies alongside session re-use under advanced browser control. Nothing shows a session identifier pinning multiple requests to the same proxy IP, so sticky identity has to be inferred from combining these separate features. Missing for 10: explicit sticky-proxy or session-to-proxy binding, documentation of a session ID parameter tied to proxy selection, hands-on corroboration of a consistent IP across requests.
